# A boss turret: a dark drum 0.6 across with twin barrels 0.55 long to -Y. Pivot at the drum's base centre.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Dark --base-color 0.224 0.165 0.110 --no-slot
material new Steel --base-color 0.573 0.494 0.416 --no-slot
material new Metal --base-color 0.408 0.298 0.235 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Drum --vertices 8 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.2 --location 0 0 0.1
material assign Metal
add mesh cube --name Barrel1 --size 1 --location -0.100 -0.400 0.120
scale 0.090 0.550 0.090
apply --scale
select Barrel1
material assign Steel
add mesh cube --name Barrel2 --size 1 --location 0.100 -0.400 0.120
scale 0.090 0.550 0.090
apply --scale
select Barrel2
material assign Steel
add mesh cylinder --name Top --vertices 8 --radius 0.16 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0 0.22
material assign Dark
select all
shade flat
export bossgun.glb
